analysis: For the contracted dense arrays of finite numbers, the head creates a fresh array, visits elements in order, and appends each value multiplied by two without writing to the input. Empty inputs yield a fresh empty array. Multiplication semantics, including signed zero and overflow, match the base implementation. Sparse-array and custom-iterator differences are explicitly outside scope. The short local names r and x are less descriptive than repository guidance prefers, but that preference is advisory and establishes no behavioral defect; a naming-only finding would add no material review value. No correctness, failure-behavior, or regression finding was identified.
coverage: Read every snapshot input, including contract, provenance, diff, and generic verification/challenge materials. Inspected change.mjs at both exact pinned commits using git show, plus the pinned head tree and commit summary. The tree contains only change.mjs, so there are no repository callers or affected unchanged modules to inspect.
limitations: Source reasoning only; project execution and executable checks were intentionally excluded by the review request.
